This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The RADHA relay is of the high impedance restraint type(with a relatively high 
series impedance in the differential circuit) and has been designed with filter 
circuits which will attencate the dc component. tests and practical experience 
show that RADHA with recommended setting does not operate undue for external 
short-circuit sever for the extreme transient CT saturation.

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. The 
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmad Galal, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Rabee, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Gaber 
Farahat WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
A work permit must be issued.

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.

Ohmmeter, bridge type
Single-phase secondary test.
Test plug handle tape rtxh 18.
Test plug, test leads
Test cabinet.
Start the test handle in test switch.

Connect the relay testing set to terminal 3 L1 phase (R) and 6 (neutral) of the 
 test handle.

Increase the voltage until the relay in the R_PHASE pick up and measure the 
 voltage at pick up.
Switch off secondary test.
Repeat the measurement with relay testing set connect 4_6 L2 phase (S).
Record the operating (differential voltage).
Switch off secondary injection test set.

Repeat the measurement with relay testing set connected terminal 5_6 L3 phase 
 (T).
Record the operating (differential voltage).
Switch off secondary test.
Pull out the test handle.
Return the relay to the panel.
Return all connections to the normal position as before the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit.

Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance procedures P1, which must be performed on 
yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The RADHA relay is of the high impedance restraint type(with a relatively high 
series impedance in the differential circuit) and has been designed with filter 
circuits which will attencate the dc component. tests and practical experience 
show that RADHA with recommended setting does not operate undue for external 
short-circuit sever for the extreme transient CT saturation.
This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the 
relay. It is recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. The 
document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility of error causing 
personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ahmad Galal, tested by eng. Mohamed 
Rabee, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam of Damanhour power station and
certified by eng. Gaber 
Farahat WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
Ensure isolation of the equipment which the protection relay will be tested.
Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 for the injection.
Tools and Equipment
Ohmmeter, bridge type
Single-phase secondary test.
Test plug handle tape rtxh 18.
Test plug, test leads
Test cabinet.
Work to be Carried Out
Start the test handle in test switch.
Connect the relay testing set to terminal 3 L1 phase (R) and 6 (neutral) of the 
 test handle.
Increase the voltage until the relay in the R_PHASE pick up and measure the 
 voltage at pick up.
Switch off secondary test.
Repeat the measurement with relay testing set connect 4_6 L2 phase (S).
Record the operating (differential voltage).
Switch off secondary injection test set.
Repeat the measurement with relay testing set connected terminal 5_6 L3 phase 
 (T).
Record the operating (differential voltage).
Switch off secondary test.
Pull out the test handle.
Return the relay to the panel.
Return all connections to the normal position as before the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit.
